activity.notes: Richard I, known as Richard the Lionheart, reigned as King of England from 1189 until his death on 6 April 1199. The Royal Family gives his reign as 1189-1199, and Westminster Abbey records his coronation on 3 September 1189 and death on 6 April 1199. ATLAS records his English sovereign reign as the representative Activity and does not create additional concurrent French territorial Activities in this registration.

sources.citation_text: The Royal Family identifies Richard I as reigning from 1189 to 1199 and describes his kingship and death during the siege of Chalus.
